password.title: Msheireb resident portal
password.description: Use your Msheireb resident portal login.

portal_session.title: Sign in with portal session
portal_session.description:
Sign in on the Msheireb portal in your browser, then hand the session to Home Assistant. It contains your refresh token; treat it like a password.

## A. Send to HA (one tap, set up once)
Your phone or computer must be able to reach Home Assistant at `{webhook_url}` (at home, or through remote access such as Nabu Casa).

```
{send_bookmarklet}
```

1. Tap and hold the code above to copy it (it is personal to this Home Assistant and stays the same next time).
2. Add any page as a bookmark, edit it, name it `Send Msheireb to HA` and replace its URL with the code.
3. Open [web-prod.mp-mdd.com](https://web-prod.mp-mdd.com) and sign in.
4. Run the bookmark (iPhone Safari: Bookmarks > tap it; Android Chrome: type its name in the address bar and tap the suggestion).
5. When it says *Sent to Home Assistant*, come back here, leave the field below empty and tap **Submit**.

## B. Copy and paste
Copy bookmarklet (tap and hold to copy):

```
{bookmarklet}
```

**On a phone (iPhone Safari or Android Chrome), one-time setup**
1. Tap and hold the code above to copy it.
2. In your browser, add any page as a bookmark (iPhone Safari: Share > Add Bookmark; Android Chrome: ⋮ > ☆).
3. Edit that bookmark: name it `Copy Msheireb session` and replace its URL with the code you copied.
4. Open [web-prod.mp-mdd.com](https://web-prod.mp-mdd.com) and sign in.
5. Run the bookmark. iPhone Safari: open Bookmarks and tap it. Android Chrome: type the bookmark name in the address bar and tap the bookmark in the suggestions.
6. When it says Copied, come back here and paste into the field below.

**On a computer**
1. Open [web-prod.mp-mdd.com](https://web-prod.mp-mdd.com) and sign in.
2. Either click the bookmarklet (add it as a bookmark as above), or open DevTools (F12) > Application > Local Storage > https://web-prod.mp-mdd.com > msheireb-auth and copy the whole value.
3. Paste it into the field below.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. If the password is correct, try the 'Sign in with portal session' option instead.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Msheireb portal.
error.captcha_required: The portal requires a captcha for password login. Go back and use the 'Sign in with portal session' option.
error.invalid_session: The portal rejected this session (expired or invalid). Sign in on the portal again, re-copy the msheireb-auth value and paste it.
error.no_contracts: The session is valid but no contracts were found. Copy the whole msheireb-auth value, not just the token.
error.empty_session: Nothing received yet. Run the Send to HA bookmark on the signed-in portal page (and wait for 'Sent to Home Assistant'), or paste the session into the field, then Submit.
error.unrecognised_session: That does not look like a portal session. Copy the whole msheireb-auth value again, using the bookmarklet or DevTools, and paste it.

abort.wrong_account: That login belongs to a different account.

data.pulse_interval: Pulse spacing between Temp Up/Down presses
data.drift_grace: Grace period before acting on an external change
data.adopt_external: Adopt external changes as the new desired state

data_description.scan_interval: How often the portal is polled.
data_description.notifications: Alerts for login, offline and failed commands.
data_description.external_change: What to do when a room is changed outside HA.
data_description.drift_grace: How long a change must persist before acting.
data_description.adopt_external: Keep external changes instead of restoring.
data_description.power_fan_delay: Wait after power changes before the fan press.
data_description.fan_auto_when_off: On: turning off also sets fan Auto; off: power only.
data_description.unlock_enabled: Allow the Unlock door button to open the door.
data_description.power_settle: Wait after a power press before checking it.
data_description.fan_settle: Wait after a fan press before checking it.
data_description.edit_room_sensors: Tick, then Submit, to pick a sensor per room.

room_sensors.title: Room temperature sensors
room_sensors.description:
Optional. For each room you can pick a temperature sensor that the **Max cooling override** uses instead of the air conditioner's own room temperature (for example a sensor placed away from the AC unit).

- Leave a field **empty** (or clear it with the X) to use the AC's own room temperature.
- If the chosen sensor is unavailable or not a number, the AC's reading is used automatically until the sensor is back.
- Only the override uses this sensor; the room's shown current temperature stays the AC's.
- °F sensors are converted to °C.

error.min_ge_max: Minimum must be lower than maximum.

reauth_required.title: Msheireb login needs attention
reauth_required.description: The saved Msheireb portal login for {title} stopped working and automatic re-login failed. Go to Settings → Devices & services → Msheireb Smart Home and choose Reconfigure/Re-authenticate to enter your password again.

save_state.name: Save room state
save_state.description: Remember this room's current fan mode (Off if the room is off), power and target temperature under a name of your choice, so that restore_state can bring them back later. Nothing is sent to the air conditioner.

slot.name: Slot name
slot.description: Name to save under, for example door or co2. Not case sensitive. Each room has its own slots.

overwrite.name: Overwrite existing slot
overwrite.description: If off and this slot already holds a saved state, the old one is kept.

restore_state.name: Restore room state
restore_state.description: Bring the room back to a state saved with save_state, using the normal commands: Off turns the room off, otherwise the target temperature is set and then the fan speed (which turns the room on). With the Max cooling override on, the override keeps control of the power. An unknown slot does nothing.

clear.name: Delete slot after restoring
clear.description: Remove the slot once restored. Turn off to keep it for another restore.
